ModMetaData.name: Tab Groups
ModMetaData.author: Ordoxous
ModMetaData.description:
Folds the bottom bar's tabs into a few group buttons, so a long modded bar fits again.
Five groups come set up: Colonists (Work, Schedule, Assign, Numbers, mechs and other pawn tables), Knowledge (Research, Ideoligions, reference and wiki tabs), World (World, Quests, Factions), Other (mod-specific extras) and Tools (History, search, performance and mod-settings buttons).
- Click a group (left or right) to get a list of its tabs, and pick one. - The button always shows the group's name, and lights up while one of its tabs is open. - Each tab keeps its hotkey. - Research progress still shows on the Knowledge button.
Move any tab into another group, or back onto the bar, in the mod's settings.
